question: A force that changes the size or shape of an object is called:
urdu_translation: object کی size یا shape change کرنے والی force کیا کہلاتی ہے؟

question: Elasticity is the property by which a material:
urdu_translation: elasticity وہ property ہے جس سے material کیا کرتی ہے؟
A: Always keeps the deformed shape / always deformed shape رکھتی ہے
B: Loses all mass / تمام mass lose کرتی ہے
C: Returns to its original shape after the force is removed / force remove ہونے پر original shape میں واپس آتی ہے
D: Becomes a liquid / liquid بن جاتی ہے
correct_answer: C | Returns to its original shape after the force is removed / force remove ہونے پر original shape میں واپس آتی ہے

question: Beyond the elastic limit, deformation becomes:
urdu_translation: elastic limit کے beyond deformation کیسی ہو جاتی ہے؟

question: Which material behaviour is inelastic?
urdu_translation: کون سا material behaviour inelastic ہے؟
A: A spring returning to original length / spring کا original length پر return کرنا
B: A rubber band regaining shape / rubber band کا shape regain کرنا
C: A ball restoring after a small deformation / ball کا small deformation کے بعد restore ہونا
D: Clay retaining its changed shape / clay کا changed shape retain کرنا
correct_answer: D | Clay retaining its changed shape / clay کا changed shape retain کرنا

question: Hooke's law states that within the elastic limit, extension is directly proportional to:
urdu_translation: Hooke's law کے مطابق elastic limit کے اندر extension کس کے directly proportional ہے؟
A: Area of the spring / spring کے area
C: Density of the spring / spring کی density

question: The equation for Hooke's law is:
urdu_translation: Hooke's law کی equation کیا ہے؟

question: The spring constant is calculated by:
urdu_translation: spring constant کیسے calculate کی جاتی ہے؟

question: The SI unit of spring constant is:
urdu_translation: spring constant کی SI unit کیا ہے؟

question: A larger spring constant indicates a spring that is:
urdu_translation: larger spring constant کس type کی spring کو indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: Less dense only / صرف کم dense
D: Without an elastic limit / elastic limit کے بغیر

question: Within the limit of proportionality, the load-extension graph is:
urdu_translation: limit of proportionality کے اندر load-extension graph کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
C: A vertical line only / صرف vertical line
D: A straight line through the origin / origin سے passing straight line
correct_answer: D | A straight line through the origin / origin سے passing straight line

question: A 40 N load stretches a spring by 20 mm. The spring constant is:
urdu_translation: 40 N load spring کو 20 mm stretch کرتی ہے۔ spring constant معلوم کریں۔

question: Which instrument works on Hooke's law?
urdu_translation: کون سا instrument Hooke's law پر work کرتا ہے؟

question: Density is defined as:
urdu_translation: density کی definition کیا ہے؟
A: Force per unit area / force per unit area
B: Work per unit time / work per unit time
C: Mass per unit volume / mass per unit volume
D: Volume per unit mass / volume per unit mass
correct_answer: C | Mass per unit volume / mass per unit volume

question: The formula for density is:
urdu_translation: density کا formula کیا ہے؟

question: The SI unit of density is:
urdu_translation: density کی SI unit کیا ہے؟

question: Density is mainly a property of:
urdu_translation: density mainly کس کی property ہے؟
A: The object's colour / object کے colour
B: The object's name / object کے name

question: A 5 L sample of milk has mass 4.5 kg. Its density is:
urdu_translation: 5 L milk sample کی mass 4.5 kg ہے۔ density معلوم کریں۔

question: Pressure is defined as:
urdu_translation: pressure کی definition کیا ہے؟
A: Mass per unit volume / mass per unit volume
B: Normal force per unit area / normal force per unit area
C: Energy per unit time / energy per unit time
D: Force times distance / force times distance
correct_answer: B | Normal force per unit area / normal force per unit area

question: The formula for pressure is:
urdu_translation: pressure کا formula کیا ہے؟

question: The SI unit of pressure is:
urdu_translation: pressure کی SI unit کیا ہے؟

question: For the same force, pressure increases when area:
urdu_translation: same force کے لیے pressure کب increase ہوتی ہے؟

question: Heavy animals have broad feet mainly to:
urdu_translation: heavy animals کے broad feet mainly کیوں ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Reduce pressure on the ground / ground پر pressure reduce کرنے کے لیے
B: Increase pressure greatly / pressure greatly increase کرنے کے لیے
C: Increase their density / اپنی density increase کرنے کے لیے
D: Remove their weight / اپنا weight remove کرنے کے لیے
correct_answer: A | Reduce pressure on the ground / ground پر pressure reduce کرنے کے لیے

question: Walking barefoot on pebbles is painful because the small contact area produces:
urdu_translation: pebbles پر barefoot walking painful کیوں ہوتی ہے؟
A: Small force and zero pressure / small force اور zero pressure
B: No normal force / no normal force
C: Lower density of the body / body کی lower density

question: Liquid pressure at a depth is calculated by:
urdu_translation: depth پر liquid pressure کس formula سے calculate ہوتی ہے؟

question: Pressure in a liquid increases with:
urdu_translation: liquid میں pressure کس کے ساتھ increase ہوتی ہے؟
A: Surface area only / صرف surface area
B: Colour of the liquid / liquid کے colour
C: Shape of the container only / صرف container کی shape
D: Depth and density / depth اور density
correct_answer: D | Depth and density / depth اور density

question: At the same depth in the same liquid, pressure is:
urdu_translation: same liquid میں same depth پر pressure کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Greater on a larger plate / larger plate پر greater
B: Zero near the walls / walls کے near zero
C: Dependent on container shape / container shape پر dependent
D: The same in all directions / all directions میں same
correct_answer: D | The same in all directions / all directions میں same

question: Two plates of different areas are at the same depth in one liquid. The pressure ratio is:
urdu_translation: different areas کی two plates same liquid میں same depth پر ہیں۔ pressure ratio کیا ہے؟

question: Water pressure on a diver at 10 m depth is found using ρ = 1000 kg/m³ and g = 10 m/s². The gauge pressure is:
urdu_translation: 10 m depth پر diver کے لیے ρ = 1000 kg/m³ اور g = 10 m/s² سے gauge pressure معلوم کریں۔

question: Atmospheric pressure is the force of the atmosphere acting on:
urdu_translation: atmospheric pressure atmosphere کی force ہے جو کس پر act کرتی ہے؟
A: Unit volume only / صرف unit volume پر
B: A magnetic pole / magnetic pole پر
C: Only moving bodies / صرف moving bodies پر
D: Unit area of Earth's surface / Earth surface کے unit area پر
correct_answer: D | Unit area of Earth's surface / Earth surface کے unit area پر

question: Atmospheric pressure generally decreases when altitude:
urdu_translation: altitude increase ہونے پر atmospheric pressure generally کیا ہوتی ہے؟
B: Remains exactly constant / exactly constant رہتی ہے
D: Becomes independent of air / air سے independent ہو جاتی ہے

question: A simple mercury barometer measures atmospheric pressure by the height of a:
urdu_translation: simple mercury barometer atmospheric pressure کو کس column کی height سے measure کرتا ہے؟

question: If air leaks into the vacuum above the mercury column, the barometer reading becomes:
urdu_translation: mercury column کے above vacuum میں air leak ہو تو barometer reading کیا ہوگی؟
A: Higher than every possible value / ہر possible value سے higher
B: Lower than the correct value / correct value سے lower
D: Equal to zero density / zero density کے equal
correct_answer: B | Lower than the correct value / correct value سے lower

question: A manometer is used to measure:
urdu_translation: manometer کس quantity کو measure کرتی ہے؟
A: Mass of a solid / solid کی mass
B: Pressure of a gas / gas کی pressure
D: Magnetic field direction / magnetic field direction
correct_answer: B | Pressure of a gas / gas کی pressure

question: Pascal's law states that pressure applied to an enclosed liquid is transmitted:
urdu_translation: Pascal's law کے مطابق enclosed liquid پر applied pressure کیسے transmit ہوتی ہے؟
B: Only to the smallest piston / صرف smallest piston کو
C: Unchanged in all directions / unchanged all directions میں
D: After being completely lost / completely lost ہونے کے بعد
correct_answer: C | Unchanged in all directions / unchanged all directions میں

question: Which device is based on Pascal's law?
urdu_translation: کون سا device Pascal's law پر based ہے؟
A: Micrometer screw gauge / micrometer screw gauge

question: A hydraulic press multiplies force because the output piston has:
urdu_translation: hydraulic press force multiply کیوں کرتی ہے؟
correct_answer: A | A larger area / larger area

question: If pressure is the same, an output piston with area 10 times the input area produces force:
urdu_translation: pressure same ہو اور output piston area input سے 10 times ہو تو produced force کیا ہوگی؟
A: One-tenth of input force / input force کی one-tenth
B: Equal to zero / zero کے equal
C: Independent of piston area / piston area سے independent
D: Ten times the input force / input force کی ten times
correct_answer: D | Ten times the input force / input force کی ten times

question: In hydraulic brakes, pressure from the master cylinder is transmitted by:
urdu_translation: hydraulic brakes میں master cylinder کی pressure کس کے ذریعے transmit ہوتی ہے؟
A: Air in an open pipe / open pipe میں air
C: A steel spring only / صرف steel spring

question: One pascal is equal to:
urdu_translation: one pascal کس کے equal ہے؟

question: A falling barometer reading is commonly associated with:
urdu_translation: falling barometer reading commonly کس کے ساتھ associated ہوتی ہے؟
A: A possible change toward unsettled weather / unsettled weather کی طرف possible change
B: No atmosphere at all / بالکل atmosphere نہ ہونا
C: A fixed spring constant / fixed spring constant
D: An increase in liquid density only / صرف liquid density میں increase
correct_answer: A | A possible change toward unsettled weather / unsettled weather کی طرف possible change
